ol.li: Live Demo (3 minutes): show the Agent working and the selected middleware succeeding in its required failure/denial case.
Architecture Diagram (1 page): show the middleware boundary, main components, data/decision flow, and trust or failure boundary.
Code Repository: runnable source, setup instructions, selected track, tests/evidence, and known limitations.

p: No long report, pitch deck, product video, or multi-page threat model is required.

td.p: The selected track changes a real Agent Run and passes its stated success test.
A clear boundary, sensible data/policy model, correct backend enforcement, and focused use of cloud capabilities.
Positive and negative evidence, useful errors, secret handling, cleanup, and tests proportional to the POC.
A clear three-minute story, one-page architecture, and README another team can follow.

p: The provided frontend, base CRUD, local Runtime, and optional ECS provisioning are prerequisites, not innovation points. Visual polish is considered only when it helps explain the selected middleware.
